newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields flat, crown recovers.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields flat, crown recovers.

text.p: Swedish bond yields were little changed at midday on Tuesday while the crown reversed some of its early losses against the mark after the German Bundesbank's rate announcement.
"Players cheered up after the German rate news and the stronger dollar also lent support to the crown," a dealer said.
He expected the crown to trade in the range 4.3000-4.3250 against the mark with a little risk on the upside.
At 0935 GMT the crown was changing hands at 4.3095 against the mark compared to 4.2970 late on Monday and off morning lows of 4.3240.
But the crown softened to 8.0753 against the dollar from 8.0121 late on Monday.
The 10-year bond yield rose one basis point to 6.53 percent while the six-month T-bill rate slid one basis point to 4.27 percent.
